document.name: HOMIO Frontend Execution Plan
document.scope: Coordinates F01-F05 frontend reconciliation with the currently authorized Control Center task APP-001-T01. This document is implementation coordination only and is not an execution-state authority.
document.rule: The canonical frontend blueprint, Master Architecture and REOS Control Center state take precedence. Do not use this manifest to invent or advance the roadmap.

last_verified_frontend_ci.limitation: This success applies only to the commit above. It does not verify later replacements or prove that rendered desktop, tablet and mobile pages were visually reviewed.

authority.acrl_boundary: ACRL is an engineering-time continuity, repository-intelligence, impact-analysis and verification boundary, not frontend runtime or business authority.
authority.runtime_rule: Frontend runtime must not read state.json or import ACRL/AUTONOMY_ENGINE modules.
authority.state_rule: Never manually replace or patch state.json. Gate selection, task completion, acceptance criteria and transitions are owned by the existing Control Center.
authority.chat_rule: Chat history is context only. Every new chat must re-fetch state, current branch HEAD, current target-file contents and latest Frontend CI before continuing.

current_control_center_task.title: Implement application shell and design system
current_control_center_task.scope_boundary: Execute APP-001-T01 only. Do not begin APP-001-T02 or any later subtask until selected by the Control Center.
current_control_center_task.completion_rule: Do not mark T01 or any acceptance criterion complete from chat assertions. Require the saved implementation, passing CI on the exact tested commit, visual evidence and the authorized Control Center transition.

F02.rule: Audit imports, route ownership and references before deleting or moving any legacy file.

rosewood.role: Dominant brand identity, primary actions, active navigation and key emphasis.

ballet_blush.role: Soft feminine surfaces, selected states and restrained highlights.

almond_cream.role: Primary page background and warm neutral context.

espresso_cocoa.role: Very limited use for fine lines, dots and restrained decorative detail; not dominant backgrounds or normal text.

canonical_design_system.neutral_surface_rule: White remains an allowed neutral card/form surface and is not a fifth brand accent.
canonical_design_system.semantic_colour_rule: Success, warning, error and informational colours retain separate semantic roles and are not replaced with brand accents.
canonical_design_system.contrast_rule: Use Rosewood or another measured dark foreground on Almond/Blush. Use Almond/Blush on Rosewood. Disabled-text colours are only for genuinely disabled controls.

motion.spinner: May retain a distinct purposeful duration.
motion.required: Use the shared easing tokens; honour prefers-reduced-motion; do not zoom, scale or decorate-animate property imagery.

canonical_design_system.reuse_rule: Use existing tokens, modules and verifiers. Do not add another theme provider, token file, duplicate verifier, UI library, network font dependency or frontend workflow.

app001_t01_workstream.objective: Synchronize the shared shell and canonical design system with Rosewood & Almond, remove old visual literals and focus treatments from active shared/homepage modules, unify equivalent motion rules, and make the existing regression verifier enforce the same contract.

work_packages.name: Canonical palette, base and shell
work_packages.baseline: The Rosewood & Almond tokens, Almond browser theme, customer-facing shell text and shared focus token are already saved on the last verified baseline. Simplify duplicate global declarations only if existing shell/verifier contracts remain intact.
work_packages.guard: Preserve required global import order, skip-link target, sticky-header offset and the current #main-content padding contract.

work_packages.name: Shared navigation focus and type readability
work_packages.required_change: Replace hard-coded champagne/gold focus rings/shadows with --homio-focus-ring and --homio-focus-shadow. Raise very small menu captions/status text to readable sizes while preserving layout, links and interactions.

work_packages.name: Unified system motion and focus
work_packages.required_change: Every equivalent skeleton shimmer uses --motion-skeleton-duration and shared easing. System component focus uses the Rosewood focus tokens. The spinner may remain distinct. Preserve reduced-motion support and avoid inconsistent shimmer travel distances.

work_packages.name: Homepage palette and image-motion reconciliation
work_packages.required_change: Migrate old hard-coded black/berry values and focus colours to the existing four-colour token contract. Keep the hero property image URL unchanged. Preserve contrast overlays but tint them Rosewood. Remove image zoom/scale-on-hover from property imagery. Use Rosewood for the footer, not pure black.
work_packages.guard: Presentation-only scope: no new route, fake inventory, availability, pricing, business data or backend behavior.

work_packages.name: Semantic market status colours
work_packages.required_change: Use existing --homio-success and --homio-success-soft tokens for active/available state treatment instead of duplicating literal greens. Do not recolour semantic success as Rosewood.

work_packages.name: Single verifier hardening
work_packages.required_change: Extend the existing design-system verifier to check old palette literals in audited homepage modules, focus-ring tokens, equivalent shimmer timing, no image scale animations, semantic success token use and existing responsive/reduced-motion rules. Update verifier assertions in the same batch as the styles they enforce. Do not create a second verifier.
work_packages.guard: Keep required foundation assertions accurate; avoid assertions tied only to CSS whitespace/formatting when the contract is structural.

do_not_create: A duplicate verifier for the same contract
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not claim visual review without actual browser evidence.
Do not claim CI success for new code until the exact saved commit passes.
Do not change route ownership, backend contracts, tenancy or authorization in a CSS task.
Do not delete old F02 files before auditing import/dependency/route usage.
Do not change source property imagery while doing palette-only work.

rules: src/app owns route definitions and route composition only.
src/components owns shared primitives and cross-experience composites.
Do not duplicate canonical REOS business, inventory, search, trust, lead, deal or commission authority in frontend code.
Do not invent verified inventory, price, availability, ownership or backend capabilities.
Until the relevant route/capability exists, buttons must not point to fictional app routes.
Complete F01-F05 reconciliation and verification before starting a later experience layer.

verification.ci: Use the existing .github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml only. It runs npm ci and npm run verify from REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/Frontend.
visual_review: Desktop: header, navigation, search hierarchy, hero/footer contrast, menu focus, image presentation and no clipping.
Tablet: menu layout, search fields, content grid density and horizontal overflow.
Mobile: touch targets, focus visibility, safe areas, bottom action clearance, horizontal scrolling and reduced-motion behavior.
verification.pass_rule: APP-001-T01 remains incomplete until implementation is saved on reos-development, the existing full Frontend CI succeeds on the exact commit, desktop/tablet/mobile visual review is recorded and the Control Center records the authorized transition.

next_chat_handoff.purpose: Resume APP-001-T01 without relying on chat history or guessing which file version is canonical.
bootstrap: Fetch and parse REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json; verify integrity and current_gate/current_subtask/criteria_state.
Fetch the latest reos-development HEAD and exact current content/SHAs for every target file.
Open latest Frontend CI and confirm its head SHA matches the inspected branch.
Compare current target SHAs to the expected baseline before repeating a replacement; ask which replacements were saved only if GitHub evidence cannot resolve it.
next_chat_handoff.current_next_action: Continue APP-001-T01 by applying the shared navigation focus and shimmer timing corrections, then the homepage palette/image-motion corrections, semantic MarketStates update and verifier hardening. Run CI after the user saves the batch. Do not advance to APP-001-T02.
next_chat_handoff.handoff_condition: The next chat must produce a delta against the live current branch, not replay prior replacements. This manifest is coordination guidance only; state.json remains the task authority.
